description: A Jupyter Notebook implementing a chatbot system using Langchain, OpenAI, and GEMINI models for generating SQL queries and answers based on a database schema related to a school management system.

methods.name: generate_prompt
methods.description: Generates a prompt string combining user question and additional context for SQL query generation.

methods.name: openai_model
methods.description: Sends a prompt to OpenAI's chat completion API and returns the response.

methods.name: get_query
methods.description: Extracts SQL query enclosed within ```sql ... ``` from the model's output.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Executes a SQL query against the database and fetches all results.

methods.name: generate_final_prompt
methods.description: Creates a comprehensive prompt for answer generation based on user question, SQL query, data, and table info.

methods.name: get_text_content
methods.description: Extracts text content from GEMINI model response object.

methods.name: cost_counter
methods.description: Calculates token-based cost for query and answer outputs.
